items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-09
items.q: he was the one that made me know how good I was

ctx.x: Emil. Well, he was the first one that voted me over happy. Oh really? Yeah, and he was the one that made me know how good I was. We're just about out of tape here.
I'm going to need another reel of tape here. I'll get another one.
